title: Removing Parts when Labor is Unassigned leaves nobody
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep B.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced work order for this test for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and "Sales Representative - Labor" reading "Unassigned" and "Sales Representative - Parts" set to sales rep B.
  • Open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Click the remove x beside "Sales Representative - Parts".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • One "Sales Representative" field shows, reading "Unassigned".
  • Sales rep B is no longer on the work order.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-R16: “Clicking the remove x replaces the two fields with the one "Sales Representative" field. It holds the person who was in "Sales Representative - Labor", or "Unassigned", and that person is credited with the whole work order, labor and parts.”
  • S2-E3: “Removing the Parts field while "Sales Representative - Labor" reads "Unassigned" leaves the work order with nobody, so S4-R17 applies when it is invoiced.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
